big_case_rationale: Parental rights meet youth gender-transition policy in a nationally watched culture-war posture; even a standing-only holding will shape dozens of pending parental-rights challenges and draw heavy coverage.

semantic_claims.proposition: The majority will rest on Article III injury in fact at the pleading stage: it will hold the parent petitioners adequately alleged concrete injury because Washington's statutes deliberately displace the parents' notice-and-consent role in their children's care, making the parents effectively objects of the challenged scheme (Lujan; Diamond Alternative Energy v. EPA), and their alleged future harms clear the substantial-risk standard of Susan B. Anthony List v. Driehaus, with Clapper's attenuated-chain analysis distinguished rather than narrowed or overruled.

The majority's stated ground will be narrow and case-bound: it will hold only that these petitioners' specific allegations suffice for standing at the pleading stage, will not announce a categorical rule that parents have standing whenever a law touches parental rights, and will expressly leave the merits of the Fourteenth Amendment parental-rights claim open for remand.
